objective: Make discovery and useful lead metrics depend on explicit evidence-supported policy forecasts.
implementation: Score only explicit discovery claims with an episode_id and nonempty basis_evidence_ids visible at the decision time.
Compute precision over supported explicit claims; keep precision null when no claim is scoreable and preserve recall misses for known truth.
Credit useful lead time only from the first supported correct claim paired with PREPARE or BID_REVIEW.
Document the forecast claim and metric contract; regression campaign aggregation preserves null precision.
